easy.def: To look at words and know what they say.
examples: I read a book.
She reads to me.
Can you read this?

more.def: To look at written words and understand them, or to say them aloud.
examples: Our teacher reads a chapter to us every afternoon.
I read the whole book in one weekend.
Can you read the sign on the other side of the street?

easy.def: Looked at words and knew what they said.
examples: I read the book.
She read it last night.
We read that story.

more.def: Looked at written words and understood them, in the time before now.
examples: I read that book last summer, and I loved it.
She read the letter twice before she answered.
We read about volcanoes in science class yesterday.
I am ready for school.
Dinner is ready.
Are you ready?

more.def: Prepared and able to do something right away.
examples: The runners are ready at the starting line.
Are you ready for tomorrow's spelling test?
The cookies will be ready in ten minutes.
Is the dragon real?
That is a real bird.
It was a real surprise.

more.def: Existing in fact, and not imagined or fake.
examples: The story is made up, but the dinosaur bones are real.
This is a real diamond, not a piece of glass.
Is the snake in the cage real or made of rubber?
I am really happy.
It is really cold.
She really tried.

more.def: Very much, or in fact, when something is true.
examples: The mountain is really high, so we took a long break.
Did you really see a shooting star?
I am really sorry that I broke your cup.
What is the reason?
She had a good reason.
I know the reason.

more.def: The cause of something, or an explanation for why it happens.
examples: The reason the grass is wet is that it rained last night.
He had a good reason for being late to class.
Tell me the reason you chose that book.

easy.def: To know someone or something because you have seen it before.
examples: I recognize that dog. It lives next door.
I recognize your voice.
The dog recognized me.

more.def: To know who or what something is because you have seen or heard it before.
examples: I did not recognize my cousin with his new haircut.
She recognized the song after two notes.
Babies learn to recognize their parents' faces.

easy.def: To use old things again to make new things.
examples: We recycle cans and paper.
We recycle old boxes.
You can recycle glass jars.

more.def: To turn used materials into something new instead of throwing them away.
examples: Our school recycles plastic bottles to help keep the Earth clean.
The factory recycles old tires into playground mats.
Remember to recycle the newspaper when you finish it.

easy.def: To show a picture back, like a mirror does.
examples: The lake reflects the trees.
The mirror reflects my face.
Snow reflects the sun.

more.def: To throw back light, heat, sound, or an image from a surface.
examples: The calm water reflected the mountains like a mirror.
The shiny window reflected the sunlight.
A white roof reflects heat and keeps the house cool.
I relax with a good book.
The cat relaxes in the sun.
We relax at the beach.

more.def: To rest and become calm and less worried.
examples: After the test, the students could finally relax.
A warm bath helps me relax.
Relax your shoulders and take a deep breath.

easy.def: To keep something in your mind.
examples: I remember my first day of school.
Do you remember my name?
I remember the way home.

more.def: To bring something back into your mind, or to not forget it.
examples: Remember to bring your lunch on the field trip.
I cannot remember where I put my keys.
She still remembers the song her grandmother taught her.

easy.def: An animal with dry skin and scales, like a snake.
examples: A turtle is a reptile.
A snake is a reptile.
The reptile sat in the sun.

more.def: A cold-blooded animal with dry, scaly skin that usually lays eggs.
examples: Snakes, lizards, and crocodiles are all reptiles.
Reptiles warm their bodies in the sun.
The reptile house at the zoo has lizards and turtles.
The firefighter will rescue the cat from the tree.
A boat rescued the men.
We rescued a kitten from the rain.

more.def: To save someone or something from danger or harm.
examples: A lifeguard rescued the swimmer who was too tired to reach the shore.
Helicopters rescued people from the flood.
The shelter rescues lost and hurt animals.

easy.def: Being nice and caring about how others feel.
examples: We show respect when we listen.
We treat our teacher with respect.
Show respect for the park. Do not litter.

more.def: A feeling that someone or something is important and should be treated well.
examples: We show respect for our classmates by listening when they speak.
The players shook hands as a sign of respect.
She has great respect for her grandfather.

easy.def: Doing the things you are supposed to do.
examples: I am responsible for feeding my cat.
Be responsible and put your toys away.
He is responsible for the class pet.

more.def: Able to be trusted to do what is right or what you are supposed to do.
examples: A responsible pet owner makes sure the dog gets a walk every day.
Who is responsible for locking the door?
She is a responsible babysitter.

easy.def: To stop and be still after you were busy.
examples: I rest on the couch.
The dog rested.
Let us rest here.

more.def: To stop working or moving so that your body can get strong again.
examples: We sat down to rest after the long hike.
The doctor told him to rest his sore ankle.
The cat rested in a patch of sunshine.
I ate the rest.
Give me the rest.
She kept the rest.

more.def: The part that is left over, or the other people or things.
examples: I ate one cookie and saved the rest for later.
The rest of the class is outside.
He finished half the book and will read the rest tomorrow.

easy.def: A nice thing you get for doing something good.
examples: I got a sticker as a reward.
My dog gets a treat as a reward.
The reward was a gold star.

more.def: Something given to you for doing something good or helpful.
examples: The family offered a reward for finding their lost cat.
As a reward for their hard work, the class got extra recess.
The reward for finishing the hike was a wonderful view.
